data.title: Strategy (MSTR) Is Building A Global Bitcoin Bank
data.description: MicroStrategy (NasdaqGS:MSTR) outlined plans to become a global Bitcoin bank at a major fintech conference, as described by CEO Phong Le. Phong Le detailed efforts to link traditional finance services with decentralized Bitcoin holdings for institutional clients. The corporation aims to build full-scale institutional Bitcoin banking capabilities that integrate with existing financial infrastructure.
